title: Drug Screening
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required materials
steps.instruction: Collect Corning 384‑flatwell plates (112 µL capacity), an Opentrons P10 multi‑channel electronic pipette, and Opentrons 10 µL tipracks.

steps.title: Configure mapping parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol UI, set the P10 mount side, choose the number of daughter plates (1‑6), define the start and end columns (inclusive), specify the transfer volume (≤10 µL), and select the dispense plan (one‑to‑one or multi‑dispense).

substeps.instruction: Select mount side for the P10 multi‑channel pipette.
Enter transfer volume in µL (maximum 10 µL).
Choose dispense plan: one‑to‑one transfers or multi‑dispenses from the same source.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the download button to save the protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the Corning 384‑well plates and 10 µL tipracks on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run calibration for the deck labware, tiprack, and the P10 multi‑channel pipette following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the drug‑screening plate‑mapping assay.
